items.title: 6.11.3 Entropy changes in reactions (reactions mein entropy ka badalna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.11.3, printed pages 137-138, with Quick Check 6.9 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Kisi chemical reaction mein agar reactants aur products ki entropy ka comparison karein to andaza laga sakte hain ke entropy change kitni hai aur entropy barhi ya ghati. Reaction ki entropy change jaanne ke liye yeh rules (qaide) hain:
Jab product mein solid liquid ya gas ban jaye to entropy change positive hoti hai.
Agar products mein moles ki tadaad zyada ho to entropy change positive hoti hai.

Agar reaction mein gas molecules ki tadaad badle to is ka bara asar hota hai, kyun ke gases ki entropy bohat zyada hoti hai. Gas molecules jitne zyada, un ko arrange karne ke tareeqe utne zyada aur entropy utni zyada.
Is system ki entropy barhti hai kyun ke ek gas (zyada entropy) ban rahi hai jab ke reactant, calcium carbonate, solid (kam entropy) hai. Kitab kehti hai ke aise reactions spontaneous hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke aise reactions spontaneous hote hain, lekin sirf entropy ka barhna kaafi nahi. CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ ke liye ΔH° ≈ +178 kJ mol⁻¹ aur ΔS° ≈ +161 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ hai, is liye 298 K par ΔG° = ΔH° – TΔS° ≈ +130 kJ mol⁻¹ (positive): room temperature par yeh reaction khud nahi hota. Yeh sirf taqreeban 1110 K (taqreeban 840 °C) se oopar spontaneous hota hai. Quick Check 6.9 (b)(v) ka jawab isi liye 'spontaneous nahi' hai. Aakhri faisla free energy (ΔG, topic 6.12) se hota hai.
Yahan system ki entropy barhne ki umeed hai kyun ke products mein gas ke moles (5) reactants (2) se zyada hain. Yeh bhi spontaneous process hai.
